scope: Preview-only tracked restricted organizational worker composition, zero-paid native five-stage rehearsal, runtime dependencies, authoritative cleanup and proactive failure evidence. No live model requests, paid approvals, writes or Production.
riskAnalysis: Prior paid mocks exercised shared functions but never launched the operational process. New actual-fork tests and trusted runtime composition expose pre-init cleanup, capture/assessment availability, parent-stage timeouts and diagnostic loss before a paid pilot.

threatModel.assets: Owner session, exact approved task, immutable evidence, central Redis authority, spending reservations and Production isolation.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Authenticated dashboard to same-origin guarded owner API; supervisor to restricted worker; central CAS across deployments; untrusted receipts to text-only display.
threatModel.abuseCases: Nonowner/worker impersonation; stale or changed expiration approval; duplicate Start; disconnected owner; partial activation; revoked old deployment; Redis outage; leaking task capabilities.
threatModel.mitigations: Current server owner/session/origin/Preview checks; full approval digest and exact deployment selection; existing one-use CAS/leases; independent central owner revoke and readback; no minting/limits inputs; provider-inaccessible inert verification.

rollback: Keep paid false; remove temporary inert window, revoke all test records and verify old/current/replacement brokers. Restore reviewed feature source only if needed; preserve historical ledger/evidence and Production.

defects.rootCause: The only tracked restricted launcher admitted an inert transport profile, while paid tests invoked runWorker in process.
defects.detectionGap: Standalone shared modules and a different zero-call process branch were mistaken for paid process composition.
defects.regression: Mandatory tracked actual child/native five-stage tests and exact wrapper dependency preflight with no live provider transport.
defects.historicalPrevention: Missing launcher or dependencies now stops contract/operational readiness before paid approval or provider dispatch.

defects.rootCause: Initialization response loss deprived the trusted parent of its task revocation capability.
defects.detectionGap: Tests supplied privileged owner cleanup callbacks and masked the actual parent failure path.
defects.regression: Task-bound pre-init revocation HMAC, real lost committed response without owner callback and launch missing-browser cleanup tests.
defects.historicalPrevention: Original deployment authority is centrally revoked even when the child never receives initialization capabilities.

defects.rootCause: IPC discarded cancellation/errors and parent response parsing could hide provider HTTP usage evidence.
defects.detectionGap: In-process provider mocks did not cross the new parent/child timeout and diagnostic boundary.
defects.regression: Parent remaining-deadline races, network/error reflection/invalid JSON/output/late receipt tests preserve sanitized evidence and pending holds.
defects.historicalPrevention: Expired execution cannot start another stage; malformed or late results cannot be repaired, accepted or silently settled.

proactiveReview.architecture: Exact dashboard/session/controller/Redis/parent-child/provider/capture/acceptance/report lifecycle mapped in organizational execution architecture.

proactiveReview.threats: Child authority forgery, credential reflection, stale/replayed approval, partial initialization and cancellation races reviewed independently.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Existing sixteen-item register retained; new confirmed launch, pre-init revocation, time and diagnostic gaps corrected with evidence.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Actual restricted forks/native model contracts across four dispositions and faults, plus source-faithful late/error/partial-init cases.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Separate clean Engineering Auditor and Independent QA reviewed source and failed/passing evidence; no source-level high blocker remaining.
proactiveReview.recovery: Bound irreversible central revoke before and after initialization; child termination/readback; unknown storage/transport remains unconfirmed and denied.
